role: The single encrypted envelope for every iCloud payload (sessions, live backups, settings): EMQC magic + version byte + AES-GCM combined box sealed with a synchronizable iCloud-Keychain cloud key. sealForUpload is the upload entry point and fails closed (CloudSyncError.encryptionUnavailable) when no key can be read or made; decode also opens legacy FR (EncryptionManager archive key) payloads and passes unframed legacy bytes through.
types: CloudPayloadCodec: enum — sealForUpload/encode/decode, multi-key Keychain management
CloudPayloadCodec.KeyStore: struct (Sendable) — read/add closures over where keys live; .keychain is the iCloud Keychain
state: kc:com.chrissharp.flowrecovery.cloud (synchronizable generic passwords, accounts cloud-payload-key-v1 and cloud-payload-key-id-<UUID>)
kc service constant com.chrissharp.flowrecovery.cloud; legacyAccount cloud-payload-key-v1; accountPrefix cloud-payload-key-id-
toplevel: Static constants only; CloudPayloadCodec.KeyStore.keychain wraps storedKeys() and create(). Keys are created with kSecAttrAccessibleAfterFirstUnlock and kSecAttrSynchronizable=true so they sync via iCloud Keychain.

units.entry: LocalizedError witness; read via localizedDescription in sync error lines

units.does: Seals a payload bound for CloudKit (session records, live backups, settings): gets writingKey from store (the iCloud Keychain by default), which may create a key only when mayCreateKey — by default only while the iCloud account is confirmed (CloudAccountIdentity.isConfirmed: a synchronizable key made after an Apple ID switch would travel into the new account's iCloud Keychain) — and returns seal(_:with:) under it. When no key can be read, or none may be made, it logs and throws CloudSyncError.encryptionUnavailable, so nothing is uploaded unencrypted.

writes: kc:com.chrissharp.flowrecovery.cloud (synchronizable generic passwords, accounts cloud-payload-key-v1 and cloud-payload-key-id-<UUID>) (new key when none)

branches.effect: log the error and throw CloudSyncError.encryptionUnavailable; otherwise seal under the key

units.does: The codec's own round trip (nothing bound for iCloud uses it): seals the payload with seal(_:with:) under writingKey(mayCreate: true) (created when the device has none); key and seal errors propagate unchanged.
Seals the payload with AES-GCM under the given key and returns magic EMQC + version byte + the combined box.

units.does: Decodes a cloud payload: EMQC → openCurrent with the cloud keys; FR → EncryptionManager.decrypt with the device archive key; otherwise returns raw unchanged (pre-encryption compressed record).

branches.effect: decrypt with archive key (throws on other devices); else return raw unchanged

units.does: Checks the version byte after the magic and opens the AES-GCM box with every stored cloud key.
Tries each key; returns the first successful AES.GCM.open; authenticationFailure moves to the next key; other errors throw; no key opens → noMatchingKey.

branches.effect: continue to next key; other errors propagate

units.does: Returns store's key under the primary account (no lock); when there is none, takes the keyCreation lock, re-checks, and adds a new key to store only when mayCreate, so concurrent first writers create one key between them; without mayCreate logs and throws CloudSyncError.encryptionUnavailable. Read failures propagate (no key minted over a locked Keychain). store defaults to the iCloud Keychain.
